bds.lede: Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday to be speaker of the U.S. House, as he brushed past skeptics and was on track to make history as the nation’s first Black lawmaker with the gavel.
rows: ABC News
Hakeem Jeffries is set to become the first Black speaker of the House.
Fox News
James Carville and strategist Yemisi Egbewole criticized the far left's attacks on Rep. Hakeem Jeffries as House Democrats nominated him for speaker on Wednesday.
CTV News
Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday to be speaker of the U.S. House, as he brushed past skeptics and was on track to make history as the nation’s first Black lawmaker with the gavel.
CBS News
Rep. Hakeem Jeffries spoke Wednesday after winning the Democratic nomination for House speaker. Katherine Clark, who became the first woman elected House majority leader, also spoke.
CBC News

Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday to be speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, as he brushed past skeptics and was on track to make history as the country's first Black American with the gavel.

The nomination sets him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber when Democrats take control of the House in January.
